concept: DynamoDB global tables: multi-Region active-active reads and writes
tests: How to get low-latency reads and the ability to write in multiple Regions for a DynamoDB table.
expected: DynamoDB global tables — multi-Region multi-active replication, local reads and writes in each Region. Triggers: "multiple Regions", "write in any Region", "low latency".
why_not: DAX — a read cache within a single Region; on-demand — a capacity mode; Streams alone don't create active-active replicas.
